name: Bruce's Bridge lot on Sinks Canyon Road (waterfall trail parking)
basis: Mountain Project The Granite 'Getting There': 'Drive up Sinks Canyon Road past the limestone to the parking lot for Bruce's Bridge and the popular waterfall trail.' Brief has a trailhead named Bruce's Bridge Trailhead (n10587941394) and this asphalt parking polygon ~12 m from it; same spot. ~1 km from the area coordinate.
